column1: What ERS modes should I run?
For qualifying, mostly medium and overtake. Hotlap for the long straights, like Monza or Vegas. Medium for the twisty sections, and overtake out of slow corners / short straights.
For the race, don't be scared to turn the ERS off for some periods, as upshifting with no ERS will kick-start the recharge process. Be aware that turning the ERS off does cost you tons of speed.
What's up with the wings? Do they work?

F1 24 is completely different to previous games, and now we get rotation / downforce through the ride-height and rollbars more. For tracks such as Spain, Hungary, Qatar and Zandvoort, a standard 50-36 wing 21-21 rollbar combo will leave you in a bad place, as you're missing out on crucial rear downforce.

This situation is that if you make one wrong move the car can just die on you, but with 5-21/10-21 arb the rotation comes much more naturally, and we are able to run much more rear wing without losing rotation. However, the extra rotation isn't for everyone - run a bit more roll-bar if struggling with oversteer.
Rain is certainly a drift simulator in F1 24, but the change list is the same: +10 clicks wing inters and an extra 2 clicks of ride height
